description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Government Factory
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. S.N.B.M. Padmasiri, who served as the Director General of the Department of Government Factory, retired from the Public Service effective from 2026-10-31, upon the completion of 60 years of age. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to appoint                 Mr. K.U.K. Kongahawatta, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, presently serving as the Director (Works) of the Department of Government Factory, to act full time in the vacant Post of Director General of the Department of Government Factory with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.
